description: Rename a form, move it to a folder, change its submit-button text, timezone or language, or activate/deactivate it (with a message shown while inactive). Reversible. Formstack: PUT /forms/{formId}.

disabled_message.description: Message shown while the form is inactive.

folder.description: Folder ID to move the form into.

is_active.description: Turn the live form on (true) or off (false).

submit_button_title.description: Submit button text on the live form.

name: formstack_update_form
title: Update a form's settings
